historical_limits: Diagnostic text resource and dedicated no-op stream probe only. Normal configured service remains disconnected from parent manager, metadata and replay frame delivery. No actual replay serialization/playback, active network host, six-client graphical match or whole-game completion is claimed.

Native parent16-lifetime fixture is prepared evidence, not a Rust parent port. Derived host is explicitly supplied failure0; native worker runs at join after the stop flag in that oracle. Game-wide atexit order and repeated sessions are not qualified.

Windows open_stream still disables recording. Recorded qualification owns and immediately retires the logger chain after source resource destruction; do not allow later emissions through raw freed resource pointers.

Path registration active data structure is qualified with supplied buffer/gates; actual crash-report activation/OS service and close8C8C10/8C8D30 are not implemented. Custom callback/destructor, custom deallocation, OOM and constructor rollback remain boundaries.

Windows stdio uses installed msvcrt.dll; original CRT primitives are supplied in the native oracle. Four Windows lifetimes and seven final-client commands are targeted checks, not full test-suite, graphical/audio/fidelity acceptance.
incident-recording-research.json.scope: Six incident-recording trace boundaries. AIR replay interfaces and native text logger do not establish full game replay;family backlog mapping retained only as historical context.
remaining: Qualify reader and integrate six candidate boundaries;do not mark recording features complete.
